title: Rate Desk Q&A — Analyst Hour Rate Applied to Overage on Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions
content:
# Analyst Hour Rate Applied to Overage

Questions answered by the rate desk on the hourly rate at which analyst hours beyond the pool are charged on a subscription under Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions. The volume step is 5 percent off the tier's rate, and the volume step count is 5 studies.

## Rule

Where the building's automation service plan stands active or in its renewal window and the subscription draws its data from the automation system, the analyst hour rate is the rate that plan sets for support hours. Where the building holds no automation service plan in either of those two standings and the studies delivered on the subscription in the twelve months ending on the day the charge is worked out reach the volume step count, the analyst hour rate is the tier's rate for analyst hours reduced by the volume step. In every other case the analyst hour rate is the rate the tier sets for analyst hours beyond the included pool.

## Questions

**The building's plan under Building Automation Service Plans is active and the subscription's data source is the automation system. What rate applies?** The support hour rate fixed for that plan's tier, read from the plan, in place of the subscription tier's analyst rate.

**The plan is active but the subscription draws its data from its own site meters, or from the utility bills, or from more than one source.** The first limb needs both conditions. With the plan active, the second limb cannot apply either (it needs no plan in active or renewal standing), so the tier's own analyst rate applies.

**No automation plan stands at the building, and 5 studies were delivered on the subscription in the last twelve months.** The count reaches the volume step count of 5, so the rate is the tier's analyst rate less 5 percent: at USD 180 an hour, USD 171.00 an hour. With 4 studies delivered the tier's rate of USD 180 stands.

**The plan is suspended or expired and 6 studies were delivered.** A plan in suspended or expired standing is not in active or renewal standing, so the count is read: 6 reaches 5 and the reduced rate applies.

**Which studies are counted for the volume step?** Every study delivered on the subscription in the twelve months ending on the day of the charge, by its delivery day, whatever its class.

## Summary table

| Plan standing at the building | Data source | Studies delivered in twelve months | Rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| active or renewal window | automation system | any | the plan's support hour rate |
| active or renewal window | any other | any | the tier's analyst rate |
| none, suspended, expired or other | any | 5 or more | the tier's analyst rate less 5 percent |
| none, suspended, expired or other | any | 4 or fewer | the tier's analyst rate |
